SCE.S:2F854: Works at my office. Mother is from Hong Kong. Good at moving fast.
SCE.S:59008:
...You feel as if you're resting at the bottom of a deep sea, slowly drifting upward from the dark depths of your own subconscious.
...You were born in the City. In your early youth, it was vibrant and alive. But everything changed, and the moment you graduated high school, you fled.
Years later, after university, you became a reporter for a local paper.
...Decades pass. Now, you have returned to the place where your story began.
...Your mind clears. It's 5:00 AM, following an all-nighter with your young assistant. Today is the day where it all began.

SCE.S:59808.text:
The "Catapult of Consciousness" has crumbled, and the road to the other dimension is closed. It all ended like a dream.
....What the changes in the City really meant, you can no longer understand.
..Was the Earth saved? Or perhaps it wasn't.. You can't say for sure.
But deep in your heart...... something has changed, without a doubt.....
....Your mind is clearing. It is 5 a.m., after a night of writing up small, everyday stories.
Before you, the City is back, just as it always was.
SCE.S:59808.note: ending narration: if it is split across scenes like the opening, the split point is unverified

SCE.S:5B128:
Busy with a story?
Is there anything you need?
SCE.S:5B1F8:
You've got mail.
Maybe you should double-check.
SCE.S:5B280: Mr. Fujita's place? Try asking at the map shop across from our building.
SCE.S:5B328:
Wait a sec.
You should check your e-mail.
SCE.S:5B3B0: Take the blue {7}car{2} parked out front. It's the company's. If you lose track of the {7}car{2} out in the City, call me from the nearest {7}phone booth{2}. I'll bring the {7}car{2} to you, wherever you are.
SCE.S:5B8F8:
Hello... It's Fujita... It's You?! ...It's been so long!
So you read my mail. Sorry it was so strange, I... just don't know what to do. I know you're busy, but please come to my place ASAP! Please... This might change the City forever.
I'll be waiting!
SCE.S:5BA88: Hello? It's me! Fujita! What are you doing at the office? Why'd you just leave? I'm still at the power plant. Something's wrong here... Something! Hurry back! If you don't know the way, ask the mapmaker or something!
SCE.S:5BBB4: Hello? Can you hear me? ...Is that you? It's Fujita! I'm at the seaside warehouses! Hurry! I'm waiting!
SCE.S:5BC7C:
Hello.... Hello....
I'm with the Defense Bureau. Your superior should have told you. We need your help. Meet my agent at Grand Station... Kouda. He'll wait until you arrive. Follow his orders. Sorry it's so sudden, but we need your help. For your City. For your country. I'm counting on you.
SCE.S:5BE24: Hello? .... ...It's Naomi. ...Remember me? We were in high school together... Yes, it's me.... Did you read my mail? It's been so long. ...How are you? Your voice hasn't changed. I'm at the Seasons hotel, near you. If you're free tonight, I'd like catch up. Past the lobby there's a row of sofas. I'll wait there around nine. I can't wait to see you! Tonight, then...
SCE.S:5C034: Hello, it's Naomi. Just got in? Staying at the office? ...That's rough. Don't work too hard. Today was so much fun. ...Thank you, really. I want to see you again soon! Good night....
SCE.S:5C160: Hello? It's Naomi. I'm at the hotel... Can we meet right now? I'll be in the restaurant on the 1st floor. Come quick! ...Please!
SCE.S:5C24C: It's me! Naomi! I'm at the hospital! I need help! There are more victims by the minute. Some doctors sealed off the back wards and it's chaos! They've all gone mad! Hurry! ...Help me!
SCE.S:5C360: Hello? ...Is this the newspaper? This is New Town Public Hospital. We've tried the police and fire department, but we can't get through! Please help us!! It's hard to explain what's happening, but Wards 2 and 3 are sealed off! ..It's out of control! People are dying. Please hurry!
SCE.S:5C4DC: Hello? Is this the newspaper? I'm from the congregation of the great cathedral in the Old Town... I mailed you before. The priests have even taken up arms. Something has holed up in the bell tower. Can you come help now?
SCE.S:5C608: Hello? Do you know who I am? No, I suppose not. ...I've heard a lot about you, from your friend Fujita. ...I'm a kindred spirit of his, you might say. Only a handful know what's happening to this City. I want to give you something. Use it properly, it may save the City. ...The people here are an ordinary lot, but if this isn't stopped here, the whole Earth will be transformed. Whether that's good or bad, honestly, I can't say. But I'm rather fond of the Earth as it is. I want you to stop the "change"! I live between the Old Town and Central. Come to my place! It's a bit famous: crop circles keep appearing around it. Come by any time.
SCE.S:5C944:
Hello? Remember me? Hurry to the crop-circle house. I have something else for you. I'm counting on you.
....Unnatural evolution builds up distortions of energy. The City is storing up a huge one. We must act before the bill comes due. Come right away.
SCE.S:5CAF0: Hello, the newspaper? What's happening to the City? Nothing in this morning's local edition. Every road out of town is cut off! Whats the meaning of this?! We want the truth! What are you hiding?! What's going on?!
SCE.S:5CC28: Hello. I am your anonymous friend. I wish to help you. ...However, I don't approve of reckless violence. Take care not to harm anyone else unconnected to the "incident"!
SCE.S:5CD40: Hello. I am your anonymous friend. I've noticed the good you've been doing. But we'd rather you didn't drag ordinary citizens into this. If you do, we can no longer extend you our special, extralegal protection. Act with care.
SCE.S:5CE94: Hello, is this the newspaper? This is New Town Public Hospital. We've found a way to stop the "change". This is headline news, anyone whose family or friends seem abnormal should come to the hospital at once. If the change isn't too advanced, we can return them to normal. 'Please come to the hospital right away!' Write that in the paper!
SCE.S:5D8A8: Welcome back. I've got bad news- The police called for you. Please go to the police station right away.
